assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness.
